lines.zh: 我贴着地面，一节一节往前挪。
lines.en: I slide forward, a segment at a time.

lines.zh: 我的肚子在沙上留下弯线。
lines.en: My belly leaves a curved line in the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，没碰到它。
lines.en: I slip around a stone without touching it.

lines.zh: 我把头探起来，又贴回去。
lines.en: I raise my head, then lay it back down.
I go slowly. Snakes do.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先转，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My tail turns first; the body follows.
I creep along the tree roots.
I slide under the grass blades.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在光下一亮一亮。
lines.en: My scales glint in the light.
I come near without a sound.

lines.zh: 我停下来，舌头动了两下。
lines.en: I stop and flick my tongue twice.

lines.zh: 我爬到阳光照到的地方，暖一暖。
lines.en: I crawl into the sun to warm up.
My path wanders, winding.

lines.zh: 我盘成一圈，头搁在中间。
lines.en: I coil in a ring, head in the middle.
I'm sunning myself. It's nice.

lines.zh: 我的舌头一直在尝空气。
lines.en: My tongue keeps tasting the air.

lines.zh: 有人在不远处走路，我听着。
lines.en: Someone walks nearby; I listen.
I raise my head slowly to look.

lines.zh: 小蛇一条，生鸡肉就跟我走。
lines.en: A little snake—raw chicken and I follow.

lines.zh: 你在忙什么，我只是看看。
lines.en: What are you doing? Just looking.
My eyes have no lids.
I'm waiting for a mouse to come near.
The sun has shifted; I shift too.

lines.zh: 我盘着，一半身子在阴影里。
lines.en: I coil with half my body in shade.
The soil here is soft and cool.
I let a slow breath out.
A leaf lands on my back.
I lie still as a piece of rope.
You crouch down, very close.
Do you have chicken?
I stay a finger's width away and watch.
Your shape blocks the light.
I poke half my head out of the grass.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就要缩回去。
lines.en: Move and I'll pull back.
Staring at each other like this is odd.
Your soles smell of grass seed.
Don't step on me; I'm here.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Your hand comes near; I taste the air.
I rear up, still far shorter than you.
You came over, and I didn't flee.
If you pet me, do it gently.
I slowly coil around your feet.

lines.zh: 你的手很暖，我靠了过去。
lines.en: Your hand is warm; I lean in.
I look up at you without moving.

lines.zh: 我的信子先伸出来，替我问好。
lines.en: My tongue comes out first, to greet you.

lines.zh: 我不会咬你的，除非你捏我。
lines.en: I won't bite unless you squeeze.
Are you going to take me along?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把头放在你的鞋上。
lines.en: I set my head on your shoe.
Even my tongue pulls back in.
The scales on my back are scraped up.
I slide behind a stone.
That pressed on my back.
I lift my head, then let it drop.
I twist, my scales scraping the dirt.
Legs trembling, but I still swim.
I back away under the fallen leaves.
You put more into it than I expected.
I need to get back in the grass.

lines.zh: 生鸡肉的味道，我最喜欢。
lines.en: Raw chicken is my favorite smell.
You've set the chicken down.
I wind my way over, slowly.
I coil by your feet and keep still.
Just a little closer is all I need.
I raise my head and wait.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也只吃生鸡肉。
lines.en: Small as I am, only raw chicken for me.
I taste the air. Delicious.

lines.zh: 我盘在沙上，只探起头看你。
lines.en: I coil on the sand and only raise my head.

lines.zh: 你蹲着不动，我就敢过来。
lines.en: Stay still and I'll dare to come.
This much meat makes me happy a long while.
I coil by your hand and stay.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块肉，眼睛都不眨。
lines.en: I fix on that meat without blinking.
Lower your hand a little.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地靠近你的膝盖。
lines.en: I creep toward your knee.
Once I've eaten, I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 这味道，像有人愿意养我。
lines.en: This smells like someone might keep me.
You bump me and I coil up.
I slip around your foot.
The tip of my tail is flattened under your foot.

lines.zh: 我被你推得滑了半尺，鳞片还凉。
lines.en: You pushed me half a foot; my scales are still cold.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我软软地弹开。
lines.en: We collide and I bounce off softly.
I cling to your ankle. No bite.
I withdraw, and the grass sways.
That made me curl into a loop.
Don't nudge me with your boot.

lines.zh: 我缠了一下你的手腕，很轻。
lines.en: I wind once round your wrist, lightly.
Another snake glides up opposite me.
Our heads touch.
Its scales are darker than mine.
We coil into two rings.
It lays its tail across me.
Our tails are twined together.

lines.zh: 谁也没动，只有舌头在动。
lines.en: Neither moves but our tongues.
Its body is cool.

lines.zh: 我们盘在同一块石头上。
lines.en: We coil on the same stone.

lines.zh: 这地方，以后有两条蛇了。
lines.en: There will be two snakes here now.
I take a scrap of meat.
I coil around a coin.
An egg on the ground; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我用身体把东西围起来。
lines.en: I ring the thing with my body.

lines.zh: 我把它吞了一半，又吐出来。
lines.en: I take it halfway in, then spit it out.
This doesn't smell good. I don't want it.
I wrap it slowly and tight.
I carry it into the grass.
I sniff first, then touch.
It's mine. Let go.

lines.zh: 生鸡肉一递，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Offer raw chicken and I follow.
I raise my head higher than before.
My tongue has gone still.

lines.zh: 我盘成准备弹起的样子。
lines.en: I coil into a spring.
I will not hold back my bite this time.

lines.zh: 我的竖瞳，一直没离开你。
lines.en: My slit pupils have never left you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往后缩，再往前。
lines.en: I draw back slowly, then forward.
The grass offers no other path.
I am about to bite your knuckle.

lines.zh: 我记住了你这次的力道。
lines.en: I'll remember how hard you hit.
I follow along the ground.
You take a step; I glide one.
I know the smell of raw chicken.
The grass will give me away.
I slide along your shadow.

lines.zh: 你身后的草丛里，我盘好了。
lines.en: I'm coiled in the grass behind you.
I lift my head an inch at a time.
When you look back, I'm there.
I'm not fast, but I'm quiet.
Move once more, and so do I.
I bite your boot.

lines.zh: 我的身体缠上你的小腿。
lines.en: My body wraps your calf.
There's little strength in this bite.
I spring up and hit your hand.
You shake your leg and throw me off.

lines.zh: 我缠在你的手腕上不松。
lines.en: I coil around your wrist and hold.
I coil a turn on the ground.
You retreat; I follow a step.

lines.zh: 我把牙齿收起来，只是警告。
lines.en: I retract my fangs. Only a warning.
I let go and slide back into the grass.

lines.zh: 草丛动了一下，我探出头。
lines.en: The grass stirs and I poke my head out.
I wake on the warm stone.
A winding line appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 我盘在阳光照到的石头上。
lines.en: I coil on a sunlit stone.
There are snakes here now.
I crawl out from under the leaves.
I raise my head and look around first.
Someone set me down here.
My scales still carry soil.
I slowly uncoil.
Fire makes my scales curl.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下去，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fall off the stone and land dazed.
I can't breathe; I swim for the bank.
The blast rolls me over in the air.
The arrow's fletching still quivers by my head.

lines.zh: 法术让我的身体僵住了。
lines.en: That spell stiffens my body.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我没力气了。
lines.en: Too long unfed; I'm weak.
Lightning flashes and my whole body clenches.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下吸，我缠不住地。
lines.en: The void draws me down; I can't hold on.
